title: Cloud Extension
description: Cloud and atmospheric obscuration metadata for Earth observation imagery.

cloud:clear.description: Percentage of valid pixels classified as clear surface.

cloud:clear_area.description: Area of clear visible surface in square kilometers.

cloud:cloud_area.description: Area classified as cloud in square kilometers.

cloud:shadow_area.description: Area classified as cloud shadow in square kilometers.

cloud:cirrus_area.description: Area classified as cirrus cloud in square kilometers.

cloud:snow_ice.description: Percentage classified as snow or ice.

cloud:snow_ice_area.description: Area classified as snow or ice in square kilometers.

cloud:haze.description: Percentage classified as haze or aerosol obscuration.

cloud:haze_area.description: Area classified as haze or aerosol obscuration in square kilometers.

cloud:smoke_area.description: Area classified as smoke contamination in square kilometers.

cloud:reference_area.description: Total valid area used for percentage calculations in square kilometers.

cloud:algorithm.description: Cloud or atmospheric obscuration classification algorithm.

cloud:classes.description: Mapping of source classification values to class names.
